scope: Independent source review of current Razor/CSS/JavaScript and test design for AR028-030; runtime and visual verification is reported separately by executing agents.
deviceScope: Desktop PC 1280x650 and 1366x650; smartphone optimization and testing are excluded by user.

checks.name: Aligned left label/right control grid; labels remain associated and DOM/Tab order retained
Whitespace and control heights reduced without changing 14px base or deleting business fields
Calendar presentation uses one ISO date value plus Japanese era hint, rather than four era/date inputs
Date hints explicitly use UTC and reject invalid normalized rollover; clear, input, change, pageshow and candidate-driven end-date clear synchronize hints
Readonly attributes, CSRF fields, expected version, owner snapshot and data-state hooks remain present
Core, controller, repository and DB files are outside source changes
Master ValidFrom/ValidTo fields change text presentation to type=date only; bindings and server validation remain intact
Formal UI test exercises actual picker invocation and calendar day movement, verifies values/era boundaries and prevents business POST writes

limitations: This review did not operate Visual Studio or a native Access business screen.
Browser rendering, native calendar operation and SQL regression are tracked in separate current-run test records.
No formal acceptance or generic validation for other Access files.
